name: Anakoi ~Koukousei Ren'ai Hakusho~
original_name: アナコイ～肛交性恋愛白書～
source:
Kanata, the protagonist, has been pushing away others so that he does not become too close with others. However, by a twist of fate, he is asked to help Madoka, a naive sheltered girl, to do detailed research on the anal sex. At first, it is just some touching with fingers. But gradually the girl finds pleasure in it and the practice gets harder and harder.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109891.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
男主角奏多为了避免与他人深交，平时总是刻意将身边的人拒于千里之外。然而阴差阳错之下，深居简出、天真烂漫的少女姬宫窗花竟请求他协助自己深入研究“肛交”。起初只是用手指轻轻触碰试探，可随着少女渐渐在后庭开发中尝到快感的甜头，这场“研究实践”也变得越来越激烈深入。
